# Information Systems Modelling

Seven-lab coursework repo (Wrocław University of Science and Technology, course led by T. Kubik)
carrying **one invented domain through the whole SDLC**. The domain — *ModellingClub*, a hobbyist
RC-car / drone / scale-model community platform — is specified in lab 1 and then satisfied, extended
and re-modelled in every lab after it. Plus a bonus 570-question exam trainer.

| Lab | Topic | Stack |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Requirements specification (SRS, PDF prose) | — |
| 2 | [[contract-first-api-design]] | Java 21, [[spring-boot]] 3.5.6, [[maven]], [[sqlite]] |
| 3 | Backend that **documents** auth it does not implement — see below | + [[h2-database]] |
| 4 | Flagship backend + SPA | + [[aspect-oriented-programming]], jjwt, BCrypt, [[angular]] 21.2 |
| 5 | [[ontology-modelling-tbox-abox]] + SPARQL | Java 11, [[rdf4j]] 3.6.3 |
| 6 | [[linked-data-publishing]] — RDFa 1.1 + JSON-LD | Node, zero dependencies |
| 7 | [[bpmn-process-modelling]] — 8 collaborations | Node, zero dependencies |
| — | `ism_final_exam_prep/` | vanilla HTML/CSS/JS |

464 tracked files: 134 source Java, 73 TS, 28 HTML, 27 tracked XML, 21 JS, 40 PNG/JPG, 14 MD.
26 commits, single author, 2026-04-14 → 2026-07-25.

**Status: coursework, finished and frozen at last commit 2026-07-25.** "All finished and frozen" (interview, 2026-07-28). No deployment, CI, or maintenance.

## It ships real model artefacts — and no UML at all

A first pass over the file counts suggests the XML here is all IDE metadata and therefore that the
repo contains no models. **That is wrong on the substance.** The tree delivers:

- **8 `.bpmn`** — BPMN 2.0 collaborations with diagram interchange, plus 8 rendered `.svg`
- **5 `.ttl`**, **1 `.owl`**, **1 `.rdf`**, **3 `.jsonld`** — a real TBox/ABox split
- **4 OpenAPI `.yaml`** contracts

Of 93 on-disk `.xml`, 87 are `.idea/` but only **27 are tracked**; the "231 Java files" figure counted `target/` build copies, while tracked source Java is **134**.

**The genuine absence is UML.** There is no class, sequence, state, use-case or activity diagram in
any format — no `.uml`, `.di`, `.notation`, `.ecore`, `.eap`, `.vpp`, `.asta`, no Mermaid, no
hand-drawn tool file — in a course called *Information Systems Modelling* whose own exam-prep theme
table names "UML & SysML diagrams". Modelling here is done in BPMN and RDF/OWL instead.

## Each lab is a forward copy of the last

lab3 = lab2 + the *documentation* of auth; lab4 = lab3 + AOP, uploads, validation and the auth lab3
only promised. Same package
(`pl.edu.pwr.tkubik.ism`), same artifactId, same `api/ → service/ → repository/ → entity/` split —
see [[layered-architecture]] and [[forward-copy-lab-progression]]. Every superseded ancestor stays in
the tree, which makes this a four-way instance of [[keep-the-superseded-version-in-tree]]: labs 2 and
3 beside lab 4; a **39-file nested duplicate** of the pre-rewrite student-CRUD Angular scaffold
sitting inside the real SPA; `instances.ttl` (557 lines) and `cardinalityTest.owl` tracked but
referenced by nothing; and `ontology.ttl` existing as **byte-identical copies** in lab5 and lab6.

The numbering runs through directories rather than documents — `lab1/`…`lab7/`, `bpmn/p1-…` …
`p8-…`, mirrored by `specs.js` constants `P1`…`P8`. See [[numbered-stages-in-directory-names]];
contrast [[numbered-docs-chapters]], which this repo contradicts (there is no `docs/` directory).

−1268 / +222, deleting six hand-written HTML pages. **This is the only place in the entire 15-repo

## ⚠ Lab 3 documents an authentication system it does not have

The sharpest finding in this repo, verified directly against source rather than against its prose.
Lab 3's OpenAPI contract advertises `UC-02: Login – issues HttpOnly JWT session cookie (bcrypt
verify)` and its README says the same. The code does none of it:

- `pom.xml` declares neither `jjwt` nor `spring-security-crypto`, and there is no `security/` package
  anywhere in the module
- `UserServiceImpl.register` writes `request.getPassword()` straight into the `password` column — the
  password is stored **in plaintext**
- `AuthController.authLoginPost` looks the user up by email and returns the profile **without ever
  comparing the submitted password**

Anyone who knows a registered email address is logged in as that user. **Lab 4 is the first module
where authentication actually exists** — jjwt and BCrypt appear in its `pom.xml`, and its own choice
to use the crypto primitive without the framework around it is recorded on
[[bcrypt-crypto-only-no-spring-security]].

Both claims are kept rather than one overwriting the other, per `CLAUDE.md` §10: the contract and
README state one thing and the code states another, **at the same time and in the same commit**. This
is not a claim that expired — it is [[documentation-drift]] in its most consequential form, where the
drifting document is a security contract. Recorded on [[stateless-jwt-authentication]] and
[[forward-copy-lab-progression]]; the copy-forward habit is exactly how a stub survived into a
module that advertised it as finished.

`confidence: high` — four independent code-level confirmations.

## Tests are thin, and the verification lives elsewhere

**5 Java test files in total.** Three are `StudentServiceApplicationTests` asserting only `contextLoads()`.
Two are `BuildsControllerIntegrationTest` (lab3, lab4) with **exactly one `@Test`
each** — an end-to-end register → login → `POST /builds` MockMvc flow whose real assertion is that
the returned id is not Swagger's placeholder UUID.

**Zero tests** cover the AOP aspects, JWT service, media upload limits, exception handler, or any service implementation. On the Angular side, `.spec.ts` files exist only in the dead nested duplicate; the live SPA has one `app.spec.ts` and no feature tests.

Real verification lives outside JUnit: `lab6/app/scripts/validate.py` prints rdflib triple counts, while `ism_final_exam_prep/qa_test.js` is a `node:vm` DOM-shim harness for scoring, timer, persistence, and poisoned-save recovery.
Because `validate.py` asserts no count, any data edit can silently invalidate the "333 triples site-wide / 76 for `build-falcon.html`" claim.

## `.idea/` was committed on purpose

Two dedicated commits — `6309f7b chore(ide): add IntelliJ project metadata for labs 4 to 6` (17
files, +706) and `0cd382d chore(ide): add IntelliJ project metadata for lab7` — put 21 `.idea/*.xml`
and 4 `.iml` in the tree. The per-module ignores come from Spring Initializr and JetBrains, so the *inner* module `.idea/` paths are correctly untracked and the *outer* per-lab ones are not.
A root `.gitignore` now excludes Maven `target/`, Node `node_modules/` and `dist/`, plus Python `__pycache__/` and `.venv/` output.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| 2 | The root `.gitignore` excludes Maven, Node, and Python generated output. | `Information-Systems-Modelling/.gitignore` | 2026-08-12 | null |

The current ignore file is deliberately narrow: it covers generated output without hiding source, assignment, or IDE material already tracked in the laboratories.

## Documentation drift — 11 catalogued instances

Sharpest four ([[documentation-drift]]):

1. `lab6/README.md` §2's file tree lists **`snapshot.md`** — the file does not exist, on disk or in
   history at HEAD.
2. The root README says lab4 returns **RFC-7807** `ProblemDetail`; `GlobalExceptionHandler.java`'s own javadoc says **RFC 9457**, which obsoletes 7807.
3. The root README caps uploads at "20 MB/file and 50 files/build" — true for dev, but
   `application-prod.properties` silently tightens to 10 MB / 30 MB, *below* `MediaController`'s own
   constants. The README never mentions prod.
4. `lab4/guide.txt` is dated 2026-05-13 — **before its own lab's commits** — hardcodes a
   machine-local absolute path unrelated to the repo layout, and is mojibake-corrupted (UTF-8 written,
   cp1252 re-saved).

Others: lab6's headline "no fact written twice" principle sits beside the byte-identical cross-lab `ontology.ttl`; the root README's toolbelt promises an `mvnw` wrapper that lab5 does not have; `dist/` is called the deliverable to inspect but is gitignored and untracked.

## Publishing shape

Bursty imports rather than a working log — labs 1–3 land within **10 seconds** on 2026-04-14, and
`Add lab4 and lab5 plus root README` is **274 files / 39,273 insertions** in one commit
([[import-finished-work-into-git]]). The 2026-07-09 burst of 13 commits is the exception: genuinely
incremental, and it contains the one real refactor. The tail — README rewrite, six per-lab READMEs
with screenshots, MIT licence, licence badges, then a screenshots showcase two weeks later — is
textbook [[presentation-polish-tail-commits]] and [[readme-as-guided-tour]].

`ism_final_exam_prep/` is one of four instances of [[course-as-runnable-study-tool]].
